0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 0-4 at home, 3-3 on the road) visit the Utah Jazz (1-10, 1-5 at home, 0-5 on the road) for the Magic's 11th game of the season. Orlando is 5th in the Southeast, 3 games back, and 11th in the East, while Utah has lost nine straight, is 5th in the Northwest, 7 games back, and 15th in the West. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Magic won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating Utah 120-117 in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
